## Workload

During the review period, grader Priya Anand completed 802 reads over 384 hours. This represents 2.1 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review alongside the associated quality checks.

Priya Anand’s activity provides the basis for the workload assessment. The figures show the volume of reads completed and the time recorded for that work, with the per-hour result stated as 2.1.

## Quality

A total of 71 reads were checked. The recorded agreement was 80.3. These results form the quality component of the review and are considered alongside the workload figures.

Priya Anand was both the grader and the reviewer. The review therefore records the work completed, the reads checked, and the resulting agreement measure in a single assessment.
